text: When you take pictures with your camera, you use two things: the shutter and the aperture. The shutter controls how long light gets into the camera, while the aperture controls how wide the lens lets light in. So, when you want more light, you use a smaller aperture and a slower shutter speed. But, if you want to freeze motion, like when you're taking a photo of a fast-moving car, you use a faster shutter speed and a larger aperture. So, the shutter and aperture work together to help you take great photos!
